rationale: api.request uses with sessions.Session() and delegates session.request, ensuring session close on exit.
head uses kwargs.setdefault rather than overriding an explicit value, then dispatches request('head', ...).
HTTPProxyAuth.__call__ writes Proxy-Authorization using _basic_auth_str.
_find_no_duplicates tracks a matching value and raises CookieConflictError on the second match, KeyError on absence.
Host changes strip auth. Same-host standard HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrades retain it. Same-scheme equivalent default ports retain it; other port/scheme changes strip.
JSON is used only when data is falsey and json is not None; dumps uses allow_nan=False, ValueError becomes InvalidJSONError, and strings are UTF-8 encoded.
dispatch_hook passes current hook_data sequentially; a non-None return replaces it and None preserves it.
prepare runs method/url/headers/cookies/body/auth/hooks in order. prepare_auth can mutate the request and recomputes length; prepare_hooks then registers provided hooks.
mount sorts longer prefixes first by moving shorter entries; get_adapter scans that order with lowercase prefix matching.
Session.send receives adapter.send result, sets elapsed, then dispatches response hooks and assigns the returned response.

prepare_headers calls check_header_validity for each pair. It validates name and value through _validate_header_part, which selects str/bytes regexes and raises InvalidHeader for invalid type or match.
Response.json calls guess_json_utf on content when no encoding and length >3; the helper detects UTF BOMs or UTF-16/32 null placement, otherwise UTF-8 or None.
resolve_redirects considers non-None position plus Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding rewindable, then rewind_body seeks an integer position and raises on failed seek or unusable position.
Only under trust_env and verify is True or None, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE wins over CURL_CA_BUNDLE, then settings merge with Session values.
send unpacks tuple into connect/read and catches ValueError with a helpful error; TimeoutSauce passes through and scalar becomes both timeouts.
The HOOKS constant contains only response; default_hooks derives its keys from that constant. dispatch_hook accepts arbitrary keys but does not register built-in request events.
scope: entire src/requests/hooks.py; built-in HOOKS declaration and its consumers

rationale: The function sets entdig=None, handles absent qop or auth, and returns None in the remaining qop branch with an explicit auth-int TODO. No entity-body digest is implemented in this scope.
The source defines synchronous Session/SessionRedirectMixin; AST class enumeration has no AsyncSession. This does not claim third-party async adapters are impossible.
scope: class definitions and async function definitions in src/requests/sessions.py only

rationale: guess_filename reads obj.name, accepts a basestring not bracketed by < and >, and returns os.path.basename.
atomic_open creates a temp file in the destination directory, yields a binary handler, replaces destination after success, and removes temporary file on BaseException.
urldefragauth parses URL, repairs netloc/path, drops userinfo with rsplit('@',1), then reconstructs with empty fragment.
to_native_string preserves builtin_str and otherwise calls decode(encoding), with encoding default ascii.
unicode_is_ascii asserts str, tries encode('ascii') and catches UnicodeEncodeError.
create_cookie builds an underspecified cookie, default domain '', path '/', HttpOnly rest entry; validates kwargs, updates flags and constructs cookielib.Cookie.
cookiejar_from_dict creates RequestsCookieJar if absent, records existing names, and only calls set_cookie for names permitted by overwrite.
_implementation uses platform.python_implementation; CPython/Jython/IronPython use platform version, PyPy builds from pypy_version_info, unknown uses Unknown.
iter_slices normalizes slice_length then yields string[pos:pos+slice_length] until exhausted.
merge_hooks returns session_hooks when request_hooks is None or has response=[]; an empty session response list instead returns request_hooks.
303 and302 rewrite all methods except HEAD;301 rewrites POST only. Other cases preserve the method.
get_redirect_target checks is_redirect then encodes location as latin1 and decodes through to_native_string(...,'utf8'); non-redirect returns None.
It indexes _store by key.lower(), stores (original_key,value), looks up by lowercase and iterates stored cased keys.
prepare_url converts bytes/objects to str, strips leading whitespace and directly sets self.url then returns for non-http colon-containing schemes.
__init__ creates threading.local; init_per_thread_state checks its init marker then seeds last_nonce,nonce_count,chal,pos,num_401_calls.
A repeated nonce increments nonce_count; a new nonce resets it to1; ncvalue is eight lowercase hex digits and last_nonce is updated after supported qop processing.
Empty content returns ''; unset encoding uses apparent_encoding; decode uses errors='replace', with LookupError/TypeError fallback to default decoding.
It prepends pending to the next chunk, splits using delimiter or splitlines, saves a trailing incomplete line and yields final pending after the loop.
Hostname-less URL returns True; IPv4 uses CIDR membership or exact IP; non-IP hosts strip leading dot and compare host or host:port, then dot-prefixed suffix; platform bypass is checked too.
It uses finally to delete a newly added variable or restore the old value. value None leaves the environment untouched.

Request stores user fields and hooks. Request.prepare creates PreparedRequest and forwards method,url,headers,files,data,json,params,auth,cookies,hooks. PreparedRequest initializes separate body/header/cookie state.

MockRequest exposes URL/header/origin policy interface and collects added headers; MockResponse.info exposes HTTPMessage headers. extract_cookies_to_jar constructs them from original HTTP response and calls jar.extract_cookies.
__getstate__ serializes declared attrs; __setstate__ resets proxy_manager/config, restores attrs and calls init_poolmanager with saved connection count,maxsize,block.
build_connection_pool_key_attributes delegates _urllib3_request_context; it returns scheme/host/port separately from cert_reqs,ca_certs or ca_cert_dir and optional cert_file/key_file.
__getstate__ ensures content read and returns declared attrs; __setstate__ restores attrs, marks consumed, removes raw stream. Serialized response carries data rather than a live connection.
Session.__init__ uses default_headers/default_hooks/cookiejar_from_dict, then mounts HTTPAdapter on https:// and http://. Session also owns verify,cert,trust_env and redirect cap.
build_response creates Response, copies status,case-insensitive headers,encoding,raw,reason,url,cookies; assigns request and connection=self.
resolve_proxies copies explicit mapping; when trust_env and not bypass, reads environment mappings and setdefaults selected scheme. get_environ_proxies returns empty on bypass else getproxies.
Constructor initializes CompatJSONDecodeError before InvalidJSONError using its args; __reduce__ delegates the compatible JSON error rather than IOError MRO.
Under TYPE_CHECKING is_prepared checks URL and method non-None to narrow to _ValidatedRequest; at runtime it intentionally returns True to avoid AssertionError.
api.request delegates inside temporary Session; Session.request builds Request, prepares it, merges environment settings and calls send with timeout/allow_redirects plus settings.
Session.prepare_request constructs merged cookies and optionally netrc auth, creates PreparedRequest, calls p.prepare with merged settings and user body/files/json.
prepare_auth wraps a two-item tuple in HTTPBasicAuth then invokes auth_handler(self); __call__ writes Authorization using latin1 username/password bytes joined by colon and base64 encoded.
prepare_cookies normalizes a jar and calls get_cookie_header; it wraps MockRequest, lets jar.add_cookie_header add new headers and returns collected Cookie, which prepares into self.headers.
build_response invokes get_encoding_from_headers. Its parser lowercases parameter keys; explicit charset wins, text defaults ISO-8859-1, application/json defaults utf-8, absent/other types give None.
rebuild_proxies resolves new mapping, removes prior Proxy-Authorization, reads credentials from scheme proxy and adds Basic header only for non-https with both credentials.
proxy_headers calls get_auth_from_url to percent-decode user/password and, if username is present, creates Proxy-Authorization with _basic_auth_str.
_encode_files uses guess_filename(v) or field key for non-tuple inputs, reads readable content, creates RequestField and delegates multipart encoding.
links passes header to parse_header_links, which splits entries on comma plus angle bracket and parses semicolon parameters. The getter keys each entry by rel if present, otherwise url.
build_response calls extract_cookies_to_jar on response.cookies; bridge returns if no usable _original_response, otherwise wraps request/HTTPMessage and invokes jar.extract_cookies.

prepare_request bootstraps mapping request cookies into a CookieJar, merges Session jar into a new RequestsCookieJar then request cookies into that jar. merge_cookies mappings use overwrite=False; CookieJar inputs use update or per-cookie set_cookie.
cert_verify checks chosen HTTPS CA location and raises OSError if invalid; client cert_file/key_file are likewise existence-checked and rejected with path-specific OSError.
resolve_redirects updates history then checks len(resp.history)>=max_redirects, raises TooManyRedirects(response=resp); Session initializes limit from DEFAULT_REDIRECT_LIMIT.
The local SOCKSProxyManager fallback is defined under except ImportError and raises InvalidSchema('Missing dependencies for SOCKS support.').
The iterable/non-str-bytes-list-tuple-Mapping branch raises NotImplementedError('Streamed bodies and files are mutually exclusive.') when files is truthy.
iter_content raises StreamConsumedError when _content_consumed and _content is bool, whereas cached bytes use iter_slices. StreamConsumedError inherits RequestException and TypeError.
__bool__ returns self.ok; ok catches HTTPError from raise_for_status. 302 raises no error and is truthy;404 raises HTTPError and is falsey, without requiring status200.
The nested generate in iter_content catches ReadTimeoutError and raises ConnectionError(e). This scoped stream stage differs from HTTPAdapter.send's ReadTimeout wrapper.
send uses get_connection_with_tls_context; get_connection emits a DeprecationWarning directing Requests>=2.32.2 subclass authors to the TLS-aware method.
_init populates codes using setattr; LookupDict.__getitem__ and get read self.__dict__, not base dict storage, and default to None or caller default.
_find returns the first filtered match or KeyError, explicitly allowing arbitrary selection on conflicts. _find_no_duplicates is the conflict-checking counterpart.
is_valid_cidr requires one slash, integer mask1..32 and socket.inet_aton address; address_in_network likewise uses inet_aton. These implementations are IPv4-only, not IPv6 CIDR validators.

send extracts response/history cookies into self.cookies, follows redirects and consumes content. No direct save/dump/file-open cookie persistence is implemented in this scope; custom user code is excluded.
scope: src/requests/sessions.py Session.send direct implementation; excludes behavior of user-supplied hooks/adapters/jars

rationale: The method body is only its docstring and pass; documentation explicitly says nothing by default. Session header setup occurs elsewhere and is outside the requested extension point.
scope: src/requests/adapters.py HTTPAdapter.add_headers base implementation only, not Session default_headers or subclass overrides

rationale: The entire body raises NotImplementedError directing use of add_unredirected_header; no generic mutation implementation exists in this method.

absence.also: Cookie headers should be added with add_unredirected_header()

rationale: AuthBase.__call__ only raises NotImplementedError; it contains no token-refresh implementation and is a subclass hook contract.
scope: src/requests/auth.py AuthBase.__call__ base body only; excludes third-party subclasses

rationale: links reads header, parses entries, indexes by rel or URL and returns mapping; no HTTP transport operation or recursion occurs in the getter.
scope: src/requests/models.py Response.links getter only; excludes code consuming the returned mapping

rationale: Existing paths return unchanged. The function walks path parents to a valid archive boundary, checks is_zipfile and member membership, otherwise returns the original path. A valid member is read into mkstemp with matching suffix and fd is closed in finally.
independence_proposal: New archive-member resolution/extraction workflow; previous atomic_open question concerns atomic destination replacement, not archive traversal or member lookup.

rationale: to_key_val_list returns None for None, raises ValueError for str/bytes/bool/int, returns list(value.items()) for SupportsItems and list(value) otherwise.
independence_proposal: New primitive-input rejection and mapping structural protocol contract; old parameter encoding question concerns expansion/encoding of valid pair values.

rationale: __getstate__ copies __dict__ and removes _cookies_lock; __setstate__ restores state then creates threading.RLock when the lock is absent.
independence_proposal: Cookie-jar synchronization serialization is distinct from existing Response raw-stream serialization and HTTPAdapter pool recreation.

rationale: Only a non-None value starting and ending with a double quote is transformed; occurrences of backslash-double-quote are removed with value.replace, then super().set_cookie is called.
independence_proposal: New low-level cookie-value escape sanitization; prior set(name,None) deletion and create_cookie metadata questions have different triggers and outputs.

rationale: Truthy max-age wins and yields int(time.time()+int(max-age)); invalid integer raises TypeError. Otherwise expires parses the GMT template and calendar.timegm converts it. create_cookie receives the computed expiry.
independence_proposal: New expiration computation and precedence; the previous cookie factory question only specified default fields/validation flags.

rationale: The literal condition returns True when a non-None cookie.domain is already in the accumulated list. Two distinct domains alone do not satisfy that condition. This records pinned source behavior without fixing or normalizing the apparent name/doc mismatch.
independence_proposal: New literal repeated-domain predicate behavior, separate from name/domain/path cookie lookup conflicts or cookie merging.

rationale: copy makes a new PreparedRequest, copies headers if present and uses _copy_cookie_jar; body and hooks are assigned directly, so are reused; _body_position is retained. Generic cookie jars are copied with individual Cookie copies.
independence_proposal: New PreparedRequest mutable alias/copy boundary; prior jar.update copy behavior concerns incoming cookie updates rather than request clone semantics.

rationale: handle_401 returns immediately outside400..499. With a Digest challenge and num_401_calls<2 it increments the counter, consumes content and closes, copies request, regenerates cookies/auth and sends via r.connection. Other paths reset counter to1 and return the original response.
independence_proposal: New challenge replay eligibility and bounded resend workflow; prior Digest qop absence, nonce-count construction and thread initialization cover different stages.

rationale: _get_idna_encoded_host invokes idna.encode(host,uts46=True).decode('utf-8') and catches idna.IDNAError to raise UnicodeError.
independence_proposal: New concrete IDNA algorithm option/error boundary; prior URL missing-schema/wildcard errors and ASCII predicate are not this host normalization task.

rationale: generate uses raw.stream(chunk_size,decode_content=True) when available; otherwise loops raw.read(chunk_size) until falsey chunk. _content_consumed becomes True after generator exhaustion.
independence_proposal: New producer capability dispatch/exhaustion lifecycle; prior consumed-stream rejection and ReadTimeout wrapper ask about failure envelopes, not source capability selection.

rationale: close calls self.poolmanager.clear(), then proxy.clear() for every manager in self.proxy_manager.values(). It does not merely close one Response raw stream.
independence_proposal: New adapter-owned pool/cache resource disposal; old Response.close question concerns one raw stream and connection release, not clearing all adapter pools.

rationale: chunked is not(body is None or 'Content-Length' in request.headers). The flag is passed as chunked=chunked to conn.urlopen. An existing length header disables chunking even if the body exists.
independence_proposal: New transport framing boolean passed to urllib3; existing prepare_content_length and streamed-files errors are body preparation stages, not this wire flag decision.

rationale: ConnectTimeoutError excluding NewConnectionError becomes ConnectTimeout; ResponseError becomes RetryError; urllib3 proxy/SSL reasons become corresponding Requests exceptions; other reasons fall back ConnectionError with request context.
independence_proposal: New MaxRetryError reason discrimination, distinct from timeout-argument validation or stream-time ReadTimeoutError conversion.

rationale: It tries integer version components; ValueError silently returns. Versions lexicographically less than[1,3,4] emit RequestsDependencyWarning about slowdown; no exception abort is implemented here.
independence_proposal: New optional cryptography version diagnostic, distinct from urllib3/chardet/charset-normalizer compatibility bounds.

rationale: info assembles platform,implementation,system_ssl and dependency version dictionaries; using_pyopenssl is pyopenssl is not None, using_charset_normalizer is chardet is None, and requests.version is included.
independence_proposal: New diagnostic dependency report schema/usage flags; old _implementation task only concerns Python interpreter name/version selection.

rationale: Without Host it returns original URL. With Host, it converts header to native UTF-8 string, parses original URL and reconstructs with Host as netloc, retaining scheme,path,params,query,fragment.
independence_proposal: New Host-header influence on cookie policy URL, not the prior generic CookieJar wrapper architecture or cookie extraction guard.
